lines.en: On the ice, my hooves skid.
My trotters thud on the frozen ground.
The snow comes up to my belly.

lines.zh: 我一边拱雪一边往前挪。
lines.en: I root through the snow as I shuffle forward.
A trench of snow trails behind me.
Ice grains cling to my hide.
I walk slowly; the cold has stiffened me.
I walk along the frozen bank.
Each step gives a crunch.

lines.zh: 我拱开一堆雪，找到草根。
lines.en: I root open a drift and find roots.
I shake the snow off my back.

lines.zh: 白毛在雪里几乎看不见。
lines.en: My white coat nearly vanishes in the snow.

lines.zh: 我顺着风向往背风处走。
lines.en: I head downwind toward shelter.
On the ice plain, I am the only thing moving.
I pass close by an ice rock.
The snow fills my prints almost at once.
I stand still, puffing white breath.
My snout is a bit cold.
I sniff the frozen ground.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的耳朵上，没化。
lines.en: Snow lands on my ears and does not melt.
I wait for the snow to thin.

lines.zh: 我背上的毛结了一层霜。
lines.en: Frost has formed on the hair along my back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，眼睫毛都是冰。
lines.en: I blink slowly; there is ice on my lashes.
There is not much sound on the ice plain.
I bury my snout between my forelegs.
I grunt and the white breath scatters.
Wind combs through the white hair on my back.
I dare not move much; the ground is slick.
Something creaks on the ice far off.
I curl my tail in against my flank.
I suddenly think of grass.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在胡须上冻住了。
lines.en: My breath freezes on my whiskers.
Aren't you cold, dressed so lightly?
You look clumsy walking on ice.
I am digging up roots here.

lines.zh: 细雪里待久了，就变成雪猪。
lines.en: Stay in powder snow long enough, become a snow pig.
I tilt my head, snout twitching.
I know this ice plain well.
Do not stand in the wind's path.
Your boots are covered in snow.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是有点警惕。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you, only wary.

lines.zh: 我往前两步，又退了半步。
lines.en: I step forward twice and back once.
Do you want me to follow you?
I have dodged a few stray arrows.
I let out a shrill squeal.
My legs buckle and I kneel into the snow.

lines.zh: 我的毛上沾了血，很显眼。
lines.en: Blood on my white hide stands out.
I shake and grunt with pain.
That made the cold bite harder.
I shrink back two steps.
Snow on the wound stings sharply.
I pant hard, white breath scattering.
I cannot stand steady; the ground is slick.
I grunt and edge away.
Food? I have been rooting all day.
That does not smell like ice.
I break into a short trot.
Put it down and I will come.
The smell pins me in place.
Nothing like this lies under the snow.
I nudge your hand with my snout.
Leave me some; do not spill it all.

lines.zh: 细雪里待久了，我就成了这样。
lines.en: Stay in powder snow long enough and you end up like me.
After that, even my legs feel warmer.
So you know how to please a pig.
I grunt and circle you once.
A little more. Just a little.

lines.zh: 冰群里拱雪，鼻子最好用。
lines.en: Rooting through snow, my nose works best.

lines.zh: 雪地里能吃的东西太少。
lines.en: There is so little to eat in the snow.

lines.zh: 我用冰凉的鼻子蹭你的腿。
lines.en: I nuzzle your leg with my cold nose.
A bump on ice sends me sliding.

lines.zh: 我的身体暖和，贴着舒服吧。
lines.en: My body is warm. Feels nice, does it not?
That bump set my trotters slipping.
We have packed the snow down.
Do not push; I will slide away.
I push back, gently.
This slope is too steep to stand on.
We each give half a step.
Your snow is on my hide now.
I grunt and shift aside.
I rooted out a snow hollow; it is warm.
Huddled together, we are not cold.
I nuzzle your ear with my snout.
This hollow breaks the wind.
When the snow melts, there will be grass.

lines.zh: 我们鼻子碰鼻子，呼白气。
lines.en: Nose to nose, we breathe out white clouds.
I grunt and rub against your neck.
This spot will do for both of us.
You sleep inside; I will take the outer side.
However hard the wind blows, do not drift apart.
I root out a frozen berry.
This is hard as ice.
I chew twice and spit it out.
I hold it in my mouth, in no rush.
So this was under the snow.
I root it over to your feet.
Someone dropped this. May I take it?

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把它推来推去。
lines.en: I nudge it about with my snout.
I sniff it three times first.
Swallowed, and cold all the way down.
I have my eye on that way out.
One flame and my frost melts.
I am no fighter.
I can outrun you on this slope.
My hind legs have tensed.
I know the sound of a bow.
I head toward the ice.
You are blocking my way back to the hollow.
I count the distance — ten steps.
I will not squeal; that would be worse.
I back away while watching you.
You take a step; I take one back.
The ice is slick; running is hard.
I edge toward the deeper snow.
My trotters search for footing.
Do not go around downstream.
My ears stay pointed at you.
The wind carries your footsteps to me.
I would rather not run; it is too cold.
Any closer and I will burrow into the snow.
All I can do is butt you with my snout.
Cornered, I will charge too.
That one sent me sliding too.
My tusks are short, but they hurt.
I shove you aside and bolt into the snow.
You have hold of my ear.

lines.zh: 我乱蹬的蹄子也会伤人。
lines.en: My flailing trotters can hurt.
I am not fighting; I am fleeing.
I squeal loudly.
I am the one hurting. Do not yell.
I root a hole out of the snowdrift.

lines.zh: 这片冰原上多了一头猪。
lines.en: There is one more pig on the ice plain.
My coat is the same color as the snow.
The frozen ground is hard underfoot.
My breath comes out white as mist.
I roll out of the powder snow.
It is so cold here that even the wind freezes.
I shake off the crust of snow.
At last, some movement on the ice plain.
I slowly raise my head to look at you.
My frozen coat singes and smells burnt.
I tumble down the slope and hit ice.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进嘴里，四肢发僵。
lines.en: Icy water floods my mouth and my limbs stiffen.
The blast throws snow everywhere.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的厚毛里。
lines.en: An arrow buries in my thick coat.
A chill seeps into my bones.

lines.zh: 雪下什么都没有，我饿得发抖。
lines.en: Nothing under the snow; I shiver with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在冰面上，我腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the ice and numbs my legs.

lines.zh: 脚下突然空了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The ground vanishes and I fall.
